title: Sorrow Turned to Joy
description: In the farewell discourse, Jesus tells his disciples that they will weep and mourn while the world rejoices, but their sorrow will turn to joy. He uses the image of a woman in labor who forgets her pain once the child is born. Jesus promises that he will see them again and that no one will take away their joy. He encourages them to pray to the Father in his name, so that their joy may be complete.
